text.description_html:
MNG 18526, Bellagio Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull with Crystals

Crystals Bellagio Cabinet Pull is a modern way to add a little bling to your life. This stunning Crystal Bellagio Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull will shine in contemporary kitchens-- a way for designer's to add a beautiful point of interest to cabinets. But the Bellagio Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull with Crystals isn't just for your kitchen remodel. This jeweled cabinet hardware can be used anywhere a small pull handle is desired such as on dressers or end tables.

No enough bling? Check out the Total Bling Bellagio Cabinet Pull

Specifications and Features of the MNG 18526 Crystal Bellagio Pull in Polished Chrome:

  • Base Material: Zinc / Crystal
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 2 Sizes:

    MNG-18526:
    • C/C Length: 3-3/4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
    • Width: 3/4"
    • Projection: 3/4"

    MNG-18626:
    • C/C Length: 5"
    • Total Length: 6.49"
    • Width: 3/4"
    • Projection: 3/4"

Sold Individually This cabinet pull is part of the MNG Bellagio Collection.
